scope: Odd-N chirp circulant; scalar legal resolvents sharing the natural cycle; one free diagonal; characteristic zero; nodes may lie in an algebraic closure
uniform_results: For N congruent to 3 modulo 4 the minimum is (N+1)/2.
For N congruent to 1 modulo 4 nonzero-node and nonresonance guards always pass; minimum is (N-1)/2 exactly when the shifted Rogers-Szego polynomial is squarefree.
For every prime N congruent to 1 modulo 4 squarefreeness is proved, hence minimum (N-1)/2.
The exact monic resonance gcd is 1 for N=1 mod 4 and z-1 for N=3 mod 4.
Successful smaller banks have the unique nonzero diagonal delta=(-1)^m q^(-m(m+1)/2) product_{j=1}^m (1-q^j).

finite_certification.range: All N=1 modulo 4 from 5 through 1001 inclusive
finite_certification.meaning: Characteristic-zero squarefreeness proof by nonzero modular discriminant, not numerical sampling

unresolved: Uniform squarefreeness at composite N congruent to 1 modulo 4. No untested family theorem, including every N=5r^2, is claimed.
